info.title: OpenVibe.Deals API
info.description: Routes of OpenVibe.Deals as the OpenVibe contracts describe them (openvibe-contracts 0.64.0): each operation lists the capabilities it performs; a token for the service's audience must carry one of them unless the route is open. Generated by openvibe-contracts lib/openapi.js; do not edit.

get.summary: Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags.
get.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.summary: Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags.
post.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.summary: Submit a deal for the acting person (X-OV-Subject): a link, title and what the person sees now (price with its currency, shipping, condition, availability — each optional, never defaulted).
post.description: **deals.offer.submit** (first-party): Submit a deal for the acting person (X-OV-Subject): a link, title and what the person sees now (price with its currency, shipping, condition, availability — each optional, never defaulted). The first observation is recorded with its time. A link already posted answers 409 offer.duplicate with the existing offer. With X-OV-Origin: ai the text is AI-assisted: disclosed and noindex until a person reviews it. Rate-limited per person.

patch.summary: Edit an offer the acting person submitted (title, description, category, stated expiry, product link), or record a new observation of any active offer for the acting person (POST …/observations: price
patch.description: **deals.offer.update** (first-party): Edit an offer the acting person submitted (title, description, category, stated expiry, product link), or record a new observation of any active offer for the acting person (POST …/observations: price with currency, shipping, condition, availability, with the time it was observed). Prices are never edited in place; each observation is a new row. Services may state observed_at (never in the future).

post.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.summary: Mark an active offer expired (the person who submitted it, or a moderator).
post.description: **deals.offer.expire** (first-party): Mark an active offer expired (the person who submitted it, or a moderator). Unknown expiry is never assumed; offers with a stated end expire on their own.

post.summary: Report a problem with an offer for the acting person (expired, price_wrong, duplicate, spam, other).
post.description: **deals.flag.create** (first-party): Report a problem with an offer for the acting person (expired, price_wrong, duplicate, spam, other). One open report per person and offer; rate-limited. Flags never change an offer by themselves.

post.summary: Duplicate resolution (moderation): merge an offer into another, or unmerge it.
post.description: **deals.offer.merge** (first-party): Duplicate resolution (moderation): merge an offer into another, or unmerge it. Nothing is copied or deleted: votes, observations, sources and comments stay where they were written and the canonical offer reads across the group (a voter counts once). Audited with the tallies before and after; reversible.

post.description: **deals.offer.update** (first-party): Edit an offer the acting person submitted (title, description, category, stated expiry, product link), or record a new observation of any active offer for the acting person (POST …/observations: price with currency, shipping, condition, availability, with the time it was observed). Prices are never edited in place; each observation is a new row. Services may state observed_at (never in the future).

post.summary: Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags.
post.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.summary: Duplicate resolution (moderation): merge an offer into another, or unmerge it.
post.description: **deals.offer.merge** (first-party): Duplicate resolution (moderation): merge an offer into another, or unmerge it. Nothing is copied or deleted: votes, observations, sources and comments stay where they were written and the canonical offer reads across the group (a voter counts once). Audited with the tallies before and after; reversible.

delete.summary: Remove the acting person's vote on an offer (kept as a removed row for history).
delete.description: **deals.vote.remove** (first-party): Remove the acting person's vote on an offer (kept as a removed row for history). Same abuse controls as deals.vote.set.

put.summary: Set the acting person's vote (+1 / -1) on an offer.
put.description: **deals.vote.set** (first-party): Set the acting person's vote (+1 / -1) on an offer. Server-authoritative: weight and hotness are computed by Deals (hot@1), never taken from the request. Rate-limited per person, per IP hash and per offer; no votes on one's own offer; vote-ring detection flags moderators.

post.summary: Resolve a product by its aliases (gtin, mpn, sku, exact name, url), creating it when none matches (create: false to only look up).
post.description: **deals.product.resolve** (first-party): Resolve a product by its aliases (gtin, mpn, sku, exact name, url), creating it when none matches (create: false to only look up). Aliases that already name another product are reported as conflicts, never re-pointed.

get.summary: List the acting person's watches and saved searches with their notification counts.
get.description: **deals.watch.read** (first-party): List the acting person's watches and saved searches with their notification counts.

post.summary: Create a keyword, product or price-below watch, or a saved search (never notifies), for the acting person.
post.description: **deals.watch.create** (first-party): Create a keyword, product or price-below watch, or a saved search (never notifies), for the acting person. A watch notifies at most once per observation (deals.watch.matched, internal; Deals never emails).

delete.summary: Delete one of the acting person's watches or saved searches.
delete.description: **deals.watch.delete** (first-party): Delete one of the acting person's watches or saved searches.

common.no-body.v1.title: NoBody
common.no-body.v1.description: common.no-body@1: the capability's request carries no body; its parameters are the path and query of the routes in implementedBy (an id, a page cursor). An input schema that says so explicitly, so every active capability names one (roadmap WS-C task 4).

deals.flag-request.v1.title: DealsFlagRequest
deals.flag-request.v1.description: deals.flag-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/offers/:id/flags on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.flag.create; a person): { kind, reason?, duplicate_of? } — duplicate_of (the other deal, id, slug or /d/ link) is required for kind duplicate. An open flag of the same kind by the same person is refreshed, not repeated.

deals.flag-result.v1.title: DealsFlagResult
deals.flag-result.v1.description: deals.flag-result@1: the answer of POST /api/v1/offers/:id/flags on OpenVibe.Deals: { flag: { id, kind, status }, created } (201 when created, 200 when an open flag was refreshed).

deals.moderation-request.v1.title: DealsModerationRequest
deals.moderation-request.v1.description: deals.moderation-request@1: bodies of deals.offer.moderate on OpenVibe.Deals (moderators). POST /api/v1/offers/:id/disable: { reason } (3-300 characters); POST …/enable: { reason? }; POST …/review (a person): { note? }; POST /api/v1/flags/:id/resolve: { status?: resolved (default) | dismissed, resolution? }. GET /api/v1/flags?status= takes no body.

deals.moderation-result.v1.title: DealsModerationResult
deals.moderation-result.v1.description: deals.moderation-result@1: answers of deals.offer.moderate on OpenVibe.Deals. POST /api/v1/offers/:id/disable|enable|review → { offer }; GET /api/v1/flags?status=open|resolved|dismissed → { flags }; POST /api/v1/flags/:id/resolve → { flag, changed } (changed false when it was no longer open).

deals.offer-action-request.v1.title: DealsOfferActionRequest
deals.offer-action-request.v1.description: deals.offer-action-request@1: bodies of the deal actions on OpenVibe.Deals. POST /api/v1/offers/:id/expire (deals.offer.expire; the submitter or a moderator): { reason? } (a moderator's reason is recorded). POST …/disable (deals.offer.moderate): { reason } (3-300 characters, required); POST …/enable: { reason? }; POST …/review (a person): { note? }. POST …/merge (deals.offer.merge, moderators): { into, reason? } (the canonical deal, id or slug; no cycles, not an already merged offer); POST …/unmerge: { reason? }.

deals.offer-result.v1.title: DealsOfferResult
deals.offer-result.v1.description: deals.offer-result@1: the answer of the deal writes on OpenVibe.Deals: { offer } (the canonical offer after the change). POST /api/v1/offers (201), PATCH /api/v1/offers/:id, POST …/expire, …/disable, …/enable and …/review answer exactly that; POST …/observations (201) adds the observation recorded; POST …/merge adds merged { id, slug } and the before/after of the change; POST …/unmerge adds from { id, slug } and before/after.

deals.offer-submit-request.v1.title: DealsOfferSubmitRequest
deals.offer-submit-request.v1.description: deals.offer-submit-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/offers on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.offer.submit; a signed-in person, or a service acting for one; X-OV-Origin: ai holds the text for review). url (an http(s) link to the offer; a link already posted is 409 offer.duplicate) and title (3-200 characters) are required; a price or shipping cost needs its currency; expires_at may not be in the past. The first price observation is recorded with it.

product.description: Product aliases to resolve (or create) the product.

price.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

shipping.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

deals.offer-update-request.v1.title: DealsOfferUpdateRequest
deals.offer-update-request.v1.description: deals.offer-update-request@1: bodies of deals.offer.update on OpenVibe.Deals. PATCH /api/v1/offers/:id (the submitter or a moderator): { title?, description?, category?, expires_at?, product_slug? | product?, ai_summary? } (ai_summary only from OpenVibe.AI with X-OV-Origin: ai; product null detaches it). POST /api/v1/offers/:id/observations (a person): a price report — at least a price, shipping cost, availability or condition, with the currency of any amount; services may give observed_at (not in the future).

anyOf.description: Product aliases to resolve (or create) the product.

price.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

shipping.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

deals.offer.v1.title: DealsOffer
deals.offer.v1.description: deals.offer@1: one deal as OpenVibe.Deals presents it (server/domain/publication.js offerDto; the API and /d/:slug.json): the canonical (root) offer of a merge group with its store, product, price observations (the latest is "latest", never "current": freshness says whether it still holds), sources, the offers merged into it, votes, hotness and the indexability decision.

deals.product-resolve-request.v1.title: DealsProductResolveRequest
deals.product-resolve-request.v1.description: deals.product-resolve-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/products/resolve on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.product.resolve): product aliases (gtin 8-14 digits, mpn, sku, url, name) to find the product by; with create (default true) a product is made when none matches (name then required, 2-200 characters).

deals.product-resolve-result.v1.title: DealsProductResolveResult
deals.product-resolve-result.v1.description: deals.product-resolve-result@1: the answer of POST /api/v1/products/resolve on OpenVibe.Deals: { product, created, conflicts } — 201 when the product was created; conflicts lists aliases that pointed elsewhere. Nothing matching with create false is 404 product.not_found.

deals.vote-request.v1.title: DealsVoteRequest
deals.vote-request.v1.description: deals.vote-request@1: the body of PUT /api/v1/offers/:id/vote on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.vote.set; a person): { value: 1 | -1 }. DELETE /api/v1/offers/:id/vote (deals.vote.remove) takes no body.

deals.vote-result.v1.title: DealsVoteResult
deals.vote-result.v1.description: deals.vote-result@1: the answer of PUT and DELETE /api/v1/offers/:id/vote on OpenVibe.Deals: { offer_id, value (0 after a removal), previous, changed, votes } — the vote lands on the canonical offer of a merge group.

deals.watch-request.v1.title: DealsWatchRequest
deals.watch-request.v1.description: deals.watch-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/watches on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.watch.create; the acting person): kind keyword or search (query with at least one word; a search is saved without notifications), product (product, a slug or id), or price_below (max_price and currency, with a product or keywords). label is optional (120 characters). There is a per-person limit (429 watch.limit).

max_price.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

deals.watch-result.v1.title: DealsWatchResult
deals.watch-result.v1.description: deals.watch-result@1: answers of the watch routes on OpenVibe.Deals: GET /api/v1/watches → { watches } (the acting person's; deals.watch.read); POST /api/v1/watches → 201 { watch } (deals.watch.create); DELETE /api/v1/watches/:id → { id, deleted: true } (deals.watch.delete; someone else's watch is 404).

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
